notes.title: Update Steam version 1.3.2
notes.content:
I finally got around to fixing the bugs. Thanks to all the Point Perfect fans and I'm sorry for the wait. Here is a summary:

- Achievements are now working properly.
- Fixed a glitch that can sometimes happen with the bomb item.
- Fixed rare trophy glitch.
- Point Perfect now supports Steam Screenshots!

Balance:

- None. (You didn't think I would make it easier did you?)
